figures.caption: Table 3: The difficulty gradient, measured on held-out independent trajectories (decision frames only, five training seeds, bootstrap 95% CI over pooled seed×frame hits, 𝑛 = pooled decision frames). The axis is how constrained the corrective action is: a single fixed token (done()) is installed reliably (0.97, CI [0.95, 0.99]); open-ended corrections are only partial—the two spatial-coordinate clicks are high-variance (0.53–0.71, ±0.26–0.35, one grounding seed at 0.00; the near-vs-far distinction that training frames suggested collapses on held-out data), and a generative field-fill (locate the empty field and produce apt content) is the hardest cell of all (0.14). All four CIs exclude their base rate.

Figure 1: Held-out corrective-action rate (five seeds, bootstrap 95% CI) against base. A fixed-token correction is installed reliably; open-ended corrections sit far lower—both spatial-coordinate clicks (near- or far-prior) with wide CIs, and the generative field-fill (Mercor) lowest of all.

Figure 2: Per-seed held-out rate (𝑘=5); the bar is the mean. The discrete-token repair is stable across seeds; the spatial-coordinate repairs are not, and one grounding seed lands essentially at zero—the low tail that produced the earlier “0/14” boundary claim.

Table 7: Verifier generality on a 16-frame probe (2 completion-positive, 14 negative). Done-detection tracks scale (open 7B→72B: 0/2 → 1/2) and open-72B matches closed GPT-4o; all verifiers are conservative (0 false-positives). 𝑛=2 positives—directional, not calibrated.
Table 1: Base-agent failures across five environments. The corrective action ranges from a discrete token to a near- or far-prior click coordinate.

Table 2: Base success across eight app families, six reset-per-rollout trials each, oracle-graded. Seven of eight sit at 0/6; Fiverr is the sole partial (4/6, intermittent over-execution). HubSpot’s six trials all fast-failed at ∼45 s (infrastructure) and are excluded. The near-universal zero base rate is what the repair rates in §5 are measured against.

Figure 3: Training seeds needed (per condition) to resolve an effect of size Δ at 80% power, from the measured per-cell 𝜎. Existence claims sit below our 𝑘=5; resolving the near-vs-far coordinate gap (Δ=0.18) needs ∼46.
